result.summary: Fixed two-seed critic trial completed 4202704 physical training and 262144 internal evaluation executions; all training and raw reviews passed.
result.conclusion: 1M treatment-control S1 -3.0259 CI[-15.0240,8.9722], S3 +1.3275 CI[-10.0113,12.6664]. Directional support not met; transfer contrasts negative in both seeds, inconclusive CIs, no replicated broad collapse. Independent critic costs 30.4 percent more training time without demonstrated benefit.
result.decision: Do not promote or automatically scale independent critic; retain both lineages and all evidence. Insufficient benefit evidence, not algorithm-wide causal rejection.
result.next_step: Bounded method-allocation review of sampled training versus greedy deployment objective alignment using completed evidence and existing external calibration; preregister at most one material intervention before new training.

result.summary: A tested sampled-both-sides evaluator completed 73,856 frozen internal hands with exact self-match cancellation and unchanged checkpoint hashes; neither learned candidate met the preregistered cross-anchor confirmation condition.
result.conclusion: No confirmable general learned-weight gain was hidden by the prior greedy-only evaluator at this sample size. Small sampled gains remain statistically unresolved; the single secondary slumbot_free positive interval is not a cross-anchor improvement.
result.next_step: Audit and repair physical-environment versus transition-bearing hand accounting while preserving legacy checkpoint counters and resume semantics before starting more training.

result.summary: Matched default PPO and greedy-advantage-margin arms completed 21,494 physical training hands total; independent audits and 18 tests passed. The auxiliary was active and stable, but 3,072 common-deck greedy mirrored pairs across Standard10, Slumbot-free, and corrected-CFR96 gave pooled treatment-control -0.266 bb/100 with 95% CI [-45.252,44.720] and only1/3 positive anchors.
result.conclusion: A small advantage-weighted hinge can alter greedy-deployed learned logits without breaking PPO accounting, but this smoke provides no positive cross-anchor efficacy evidence. The two most deployment-relevant learned anchors moved negatively, so scale-up or Slumbot allocation is not justified.
result.next_step: Retain the default-off implementation and use the external Standard10 greedy-versus-sampled execution gap plus accumulated negative confirmation evidence to choose a higher-information learned-weight direction; do not revive single-teacher imitation or this margin objective without new evidence.

result.summary: The exact frozen source-KL-temperature policy completed eight independent 625-hand generic-greedy Slumbot sessions with 5,000 durable, fully audited raw hands.
result.conclusion: The transfer gate failed decisively: -142.7232 bb/100, raw 95% CI [-200.6425,-84.8039], equal-session t7 CI [-220.3165,-65.1299], 0/8 positive sessions. All model/action/terminal/session/token evidence passed. The positive matched three-anchor signal did not transfer and must not be scaled.
result.next_step: Do not run fresh20k or continue source-KL-temperature scaling. Treat the current fixed-anchor proxy as invalid for external promotion and perform an outcome-blind policy-state/contract diagnostic against Standard10 and prior less-bad external policies before choosing the next learned training objective.

result.summary: Fixed two-seed mixture/control trial completed4206408 new physical hands and262144 internal executions; independent raw/state/hash review passed all16 terminal jobs.
result.conclusion: At1M mixture-control Seed1 -2.10754 CI[-12.96628,8.75119],Seed3 +10.14844 CI[-3.50656,23.80343]. Own-parent and cross-seed breadth do not establish replicated improvement. Mechanically valid, no broad collapse, insufficient strength evidence rather than algorithm failure.
result.decision: Retain all endpoints. No automatic4M or external80k/final100k allocation; no winner selection from Seed3 alone.
result.next_step: Bounded zero-new-hand retained training-signal and opponent-exposure audit, checked against prior diagnostics, to decide unchanged-regimen scale versus one substantive intervention.

interpretation: Execution mismatch exists but is not an established cause of plateau; earlier sampled evaluation did not confirm general gains. Do not revive prior margin/temperature methods as new discoveries.
